records.Name: 大脚侠｜全新连载火热开踹，一脚踹飞所有不爽！
records.Desc: 本期漫画推荐：《大脚侠》#r每个人心里都有想一脚踹飞的东西——烦人的规矩、讨厌的家伙、又或只是今天的坏心情。这部新漫画，热血爽快，替你把它们统统摆平。#r“听好了，朋友们！ 你可以叫我莱尔斯，但我更希望你们叫我大脚侠。 这不是因为我脚很大，而是我会一个大脚踹飞那些烦人的家伙！” #r没什么事是一脚解决不了的，如果有——那就再来一脚！

records.Name: 东湖酱鱼竟能做好吃？知味楼华丽转身！
records.Desc: 凌云名菜东湖酱鱼，多年来饱受诟病——什么“酱味盖过鱼味”“本地人都不吃”，我之前去老字号知味楼吃也踩过雷，酱汁太咸鱼肉一般，感觉鱼和酱各忙各的。 #r听说前段时间知味楼换了主厨，抱着再给一次机会的心态又去了。 结果还真不一样了。鱼肉鲜嫩，筷子能轻松夹起，酱汁变成甜口带一丝回酸的复合味，细品还能品出几分蟹味。虽然称不上惊艳，但远不像之前那么震撼。另外龙栖虾仁也值得一试——虾肉弹嫩鲜甜，芽叶清香解腻，十分惊喜。 #r知味楼这次改得挺认真的，值得再给东湖酱鱼一次机会。  #r本帖没收知味楼一分钱，纯属自来水，知味楼看到尽快给我打钱！

records.Name: 打工人必看！三分钟缓解颈椎不适
records.Desc: 1.仰头拉毛巾#r毛巾置于颈上，双手拉稳两端，头缓慢后仰，感受颈前侧拉伸#r重复10次#r2.拉伸颈前肌#r双手合十拇指放下颚，手臂均匀缓慢发力轻推，头向上后方牵拉，保持15秒#r重复10次#r3.左右拉伸颈部#r站姿放松，头部带动颈部缓慢向左右侧拉伸，感受侧方肌肉舒展#r重复20次

records.Name: Notice of Temporary Closure of Whalebone Library
records.Desc: Thank you for your continued support of Whalebone Library.#r       In recent weeks, both in‑person visits and online literature searches have grown far beyond expectations, especially in the Industrial Technology section. We are encouraged by this strong interest, but the library is now operating close to capacity, making it difficult to ensure safety and maintain a comfortable environment.#r       To protect our collections, safeguard system integrity, and carry out essential upgrades and core server maintenance to meet future demand, the library will be temporarily closed starting next week. The reopening date will be announced on our official website and social media channels.#r       During the closure, borrowing, returns, and in‑library activities will be suspended. Online database access will be limited, and some public search permissions will be temporarily unavailable. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding as we work to restore a secure and welcoming environment for all readers.#r

records.Name: Special Event “The Story of Whalebone” Begins!
records.Desc: The great whale skeleton has always been the symbol of Whalebone Library, greeting every visitor since the day we opened. But do you know where these bones came from, or what they tell us?#r       We will host a special guided tour and lecture titled “The Story of Whalebone,” unveiling the history of our museum and the tales behind the library’s iconic whale bones.#r       Our curators will explain in detail the origins of this whale and its close connection to the development of Nova City. They will also share the story of the library’s founding, the design concept behind this unique building, and lead you through areas normally closed to the public. Come and experience a remarkable chapter where Nova City’s architecture and history meet.#r       This event is free of charge, but places are limited to 30 participants. Applications can be submitted via the form on our official website.#r

records.Name: Manufacturing Processes for Precision Machinery
records.Desc: Written by Koichi, the legendary chief engineer of Nova City Heavy Industries, this book is regarded as a cornerstone in the field of precision manufacturing. It covers everything from the cutting, grinding, and polishing of micron‑scale components to advanced CNC techniques for complex curved surfaces. Drawing on decades of personal experience, the author explains in clear and accessible terms how to achieve and maintain the highest levels of machining accuracy. Beyond serving as an essential reference for mechanical engineers, the later chapters explore ultra‑precision methods for processing special alloy parts under extreme temperature and high‑pressure conditions—technologies believed to have originated from the demands of early urban defense systems.

records.Name: Principles of Modern Engineering Design
records.Desc: This book systematically presents the core ideas and methodologies of modern engineering design, emphasizing full life‑cycle management from requirements analysis and conceptual design to system integration and final testing. Dupont, the author, weaves together advanced concepts and illustrates them through a wealth of practical case studies. At the heart of the work lies a guiding principle: an outstanding design must not only meet functional requirements, but also strike the optimal balance among cost, reliability, and maintainability.

records.Name: Advanced Engineering Mathematics
records.Desc: This book focuses on solving complex mathematical problems encountered in engineering practice, rather than on purely theoretical derivations. Topics include matrix operations, numerical solutions of partial differential equations, finite element analysis, and the application of Fourier transforms in signal processing. Through numerous engineering examples, the text closely links abstract mathematical tools with real‑world problems, aiming to strengthen engineers’ ability to use mathematical models to tackle complex systems. Whether in structural mechanics analysis or fluid dynamics simulation, the computational methods presented here provide an indispensable foundation.

records.Name: Industrial Development Records of Nova City
records.Desc: Compiled officially by the Nova City Archives, this volume is a definitive resource for studying the city’s industrial history. It records in detail every step of Nova City’s transformation from barren land to prosperity. Beyond chronicling the growth of key enterprises and major project reports, the book also includes declassified sections from several “Pioneer Project Initiatives” launched decades ago to address “special security challenges.” These initiatives profoundly shaped the city’s later technological landscape. For anyone seeking to understand the very framework of this city, this work is indispensable.

records.Name: Metalworking and Forming Techniques
records.Desc: This book systematically explains the full range of methods for processing and forming metallic materials, from raw stock to finished products. It covers everything from traditional forging and casting to cutting‑edge additive manufacturing with 3D printing. Detailed diagrams and real‑world examples illuminate the text, turning complex workflows into straightforward explanations. Notably, it provides dedicated analyses of the impact resistance and fatigue performance of several composite metals, supported by early experimental data that had not previously been released. These materials were originally developed to meet the “stringent requirements” of specialized equipment demanding exceptional structural strength and durability.

records.Desc: A towering whale skeleton welcomes you to Nova City’s center of knowledge. From the latest comics to local history, the library’s rich collection is sure to satisfy your curiosity.

records.Name: 空中惊现地铁怪咖！
records.Desc:
【本报讯】
今日新启市上空惊现骇人一幕：一列飞天地铁贴着高楼呼啸而过，更令人震惊的是，这列地铁竟与一名人形混厄融为一体，正以震耳欲聋的音量肆意演奏狂躁电音。
“整栋楼都在抖，我家窗户玻璃瞬间就碎了！”家住新启高层的一位目击者心有余悸地表示。据悉，这名与地铁融合的混厄怪人所到之处，刺耳的金属乐声如音波炮一般，多户住宅玻璃被震裂，居民怨声载道。
我台记者赶到时，正有一名神秘人士追击飞天地铁怪人，只见神秘人凌空一脚，正中那节喧嚣的车厢。巨大的冲击力瞬间打断了混厄的演奏，嘶鸣的电音戛然而止，现场群众纷纷举手录像，相关视频已在眼界等平台爆火，此神秘人也被网民亲切称呼为“踹飞侠”。
目前，飞天地铁事件已被解决，周边秩序正在恢复中。“踹飞侠”已成新启热点，其真实身份及目的引发市民广泛猜测。

records.Name: 桑斯特 赛琳娜
records.Desc: 它的出现让世人意识到，纯粹的机械效率和不计成本的技术堆料，真的可以让平民英雄把贵族按在地上。#r赛琳娜不仅是桑斯特的技术宣言，更开启了“战神”的封神之路。该车型搭载自研V6发动机，前置后驱布局，车身优雅，比例兼顾空气动力学。它将赛道基因注入了民用车型，但如果你因此小看它，那就是你这辈子犯过最大的错误。#r它的引擎盖下塞着一颗直接从赛车上拆下来的心脏，六个气缸和三个化油器在协同工作时发出的吸气声，比任何音响都动听。它没有助力转向，没有电子辅助，一切都靠你的肌肉和意志去控制。它是那种极其纯粹的、纯机械的快，每一个零件都在告诉你：我不是为了买菜设计的，我是为了赢。

records.Name: 艾尔柏斯 狼星 Si89
records.Desc: 当一颗推力惊人的火箭发动机，误入了一间顶级的移动总统套房。#r买这台车的人通常不亲自开车，但这才是最可惜的地方。它的引擎盖下塞进了一个足以拉动整座城市的十二缸心脏。它的动力输出不是爆发式的，而是一种无穷无尽、持续不断的推力。#r你在车内听不到它的咆哮，只能感受到窗外的景色在飞速倒退。它重得像是一座移动的城堡，但悬挂却能让你觉得自己在云端滑行。这是一台为了让你在时速两百公里的状态下，依然能平稳地写下一张支票而设计的机器。

records.Name: 极动 夜之子S7
records.Desc: 只要转子还在高歌，这个世界就不算太无趣。#r这台车的重量轻得不可思议，因为它那个转子引擎只有鞋盒那么大。它在低转速时像是在喘气，但只要你把它踩到极致，那种尖锐的鸣叫声会让你觉得灵魂都出窍了。#r它的底盘反馈极其细腻，你能感觉到轮胎压过的每一寸路面。它很脆弱，经常会发点脾气，但只要你见过它在山路上那种如燕子般轻盈的入弯姿态，你就很难再看上别的笨重车型。

records.Name: 弥尔速 RZ-49 极昼
records.Desc: 无论对手如何更迭，它始终坐在那里，用每一寸精准的转向告诉世界，谁才是跑车的教科书。#r这台车的设计思路已经坚持了半个世纪，这在任何一个行业都是不可思议的。它把最重的引擎放在了最不该放的地方，然后花了五十多年去修正这个错误。结果是它成了世界上最好开的跑车。#r它的转向精准得像是有生命一样，能告诉你路面上哪怕是一枚硬币的薄厚。它可以是你每天通勤的工具，也可以是你在周末去撕碎圈速的利器。它是一个极其理性的工具，几乎没有缺点。

records.Name: 贝凯夫 霆 4 锻造版
records.Desc: 贝凯夫再一次给那些依然眷恋柏油路温热触感的驾驶者寄来了一封情书。#r在现在的车都变得越来越大、越来越重的时候，这台车却在比拼谁更爱玩。它短小的轴距和狂暴的直六引擎让它的车尾总是不那么安分。它不喜欢走直线，更喜欢在弯道里扭动身体。#r它不讲究什么体面，内饰也算不上奢华，但它能给你的快乐是最原始的。它是一台纯粹为了让驾驶者在下车后大出一身汗，然后对着它傻笑而设计的机器。

records.Name: 艾尔柏斯 W63 泰坦
records.Desc: 它是一个移动的保险柜，而且它能在泥地里飞起来。#r它的外形就像是用钢板焊接成的一个巨大的保险柜，风阻系数大得惊人，但这正是它的魅力。门锁上膛的声音清脆得像步枪一样，排气管发出的 V8 低吼时刻提醒你它不是好惹的。#r虽然内饰用了大量的皮革，但当你握住那个厚实的方向盘时，你依然能感觉到它的基因。它不需要跑得有多快，它只要停在那里，那种“我能碾碎一切”的气场就足以说明一切。
